title: RGB Mask Map for inZOI
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/887fc8f814084a81a678ae01b962b424/images/c02e28a590b841228fa278e76383248eInzoi_bat_girl_rgb.png)Dear Connect community and creators, 

I am currently creating clothes for inZOI and focusing on improving my skills in Gamewear. My goal is to make the clothes change color when selected in the game. For this, I need to create an RGB mask map. However, despite several attempts, it hasn’t worked in the game. Could anyone share ideas or recommend tutorials about RGB maps? I would be truly grateful!

I can also check your outfits in the inZOI game. Feel free to contact me renara.shamsi@gmail.com
content_description: This webpage serves as a collaborative space for the Connect community to share insights and tutorials on creating RGB mask maps for Gamewear, while also offering outfit reviews in the inZOI game.
